materials.name: IT-958G
materials.notes: High Tg, halogen free, low loss laminate and prepreg. Applicable IPC-4101 /127/128/130; IPC-4103 /240/540. UL ANSI type No ANSI. Maximum operating temperature 130 C. X/Y axis CTE (40 to 125 C) 12/14 ppm/C (2.4.41) and 11/11 ppm/C (2.4.24.5). Time to delamination at 260 C and at 288 C above 60 min. Peel strength minimum 3.5-4.2 lb/in (low profile copper foil, 35 um). Moisture absorption maximum 0.08 %. Comparative tracking index class 2 (250-399 V).
